headline: The Hub opens in the Evening look and reads more calmly. Today names only live work, with one short line for each change you made; the week grid runs into the evening, so late meetings show; messages that need nothing from you leave Needs you; one line at the top says whether everything is OK; and a new Tidy section clears the workspace's loose ends in one press, with Undo. A project you make gets its folder at once. After updating, say "update my hub".
